| funded-then-created: an address absent at the transaction's start that the transaction funded, then created onto and destroyed; an address that held a balance before the transaction is the present-leaf row (`SATIN-SD-005`, `SATIN-SD-006`) | As absent-leaf | Refill of the charge the funding transfer made for the leaf | The address's one record given back | −1, although the creation added no rise | −1 | `−WRITE_RECORD_SIZE` | The destroying frame, into its reservoir | `SATIN-SD-019` step 2 |
| present-leaf: a leaf in the state at the transaction's start — funded before, or empty under EIP-161 with storage (`SATIN-SD-006`, `SATIN-SD-017`) | As absent-leaf | No refill: a funded leaf was charged nothing; an empty leaf was charged at the creation (`SATIN-STATE-011`), and that charge stays | The record the nonce bump made stands | No fall: a funded leaf added no rise; an empty leaf's rise stays | The record stands | Stands | No give-back for the leaf | None for the leaf |
| code: deployed code of the destroyed account (`SATIN-SD-004`, `SATIN-SD-008`) | None | Refill `CODE_STATE_GAS × code length × m` | `COST_PER_HISTORY_BYTE × code length` given back | None | None: code is no record | `−code length` | The destroying frame, into its reservoir | `SATIN-SD-019` step 2 |
| fresh-slot: a slot whose original value is zero, non-zero before the destruction (`SATIN-SD-003`, `SATIN-SD-004`) | None; the refund counter's changes of earlier `SSTORE`s stand | Refill `SLOT_STATE_GAS × m` | `RECORD_HISTORY_GAS` given back | −1 | −1 | `−WRITE_RECORD_SIZE` | The destroying frame, into its reservoir | `SATIN-SD-019` step 2 |
| loaded-slot: a slot whose original value is not zero, which only a slot loaded before the creation has (`SATIN-SD-003`, `SATIN-SD-004`, `SATIN-SD-019`) | None | None | A changed slot's record stands; a slot still at its original value has its record made by the deletion, `+RECORD_HISTORY_GAS` on the destroying frame | None | Stands, or +1 when the deletion makes it | Stands, or `+WRITE_RECORD_SIZE` | The destroying frame pays a record the deletion makes | `SATIN-SD-019` steps 3 and 4 for a record the deletion makes |
| discarded: the destroying frame, or a frame containing it, fails (`SATIN-SD-010`) | As the failure's rollback | The refills are discarded with the mark; the charges stand, or come back by the failure's own rule | As state gas | The falls are discarded | Every record the table took back stands again | The give-backs are discarded | No frame keeps the table's give-back | At the failing frame's end |
| marked: the marked account and its slots after the first effective destruction — a later `SELFDESTRUCT` of it, an `SSTORE` of one of its slots, value sent to it or from it, a bump of its nonce (`SATIN-SD-011`, `SATIN-SD-013`, `SATIN-SD-015`) | The opcode's regular gas is unchanged, and an `SSTORE` moves the refund counter as without the mark | Nothing charged or refilled for the marked account or its slots: the table is not applied again; a later `SELFDESTRUCT`'s beneficiary is charged as any `SELFDESTRUCT`'s, new-account state gas included (`SATIN-SD-018`) | No record for the marked account or its slots; the other account of a transfer — a later `SELFDESTRUCT`'s beneficiary, the sender or recipient of value the marked account receives or sends — makes its record and pays its history as in any transfer; logs still charged | Nothing for the marked account; a later `SELFDESTRUCT`'s new beneficiary is a rise (`SATIN-SD-018`) | Nothing for the marked account or its slots; the other account's record as in any transfer | The other account's record, the logs and the transfer logs | No give-back | For a later `SELFDESTRUCT`, `SATIN-SD-019` with an empty table |
| after-destroy: code deposited after the constructor destroyed its own account (`SATIN-SD-014`, `SATIN-SD-015`) | The deposit's regular charges | None | `COST_PER_HISTORY_BYTE × code length` charged; no later destruction and not the account's removal at the transaction's end gives it back, but a failing frame that contains the deposit gives it back by its rollback (`SATIN-POOL-014`, `SATIN-TAKE-004`) | None | None | `+code length`; not taken back by a later destruction or by the removal, discarded by a containing frame's failure | No give-back but a containing frame's rollback | `SATIN-SCHED-011`: the deposit's charges, then its data size |
| first-frame: a creation transaction whose own frame destroys the created account (`SATIN-HIST-005`, `SATIN-SD-007`) | As absent-leaf | As absent-leaf or present-leaf, by the created account's leaf at the transaction's start (`SATIN-SD-004`) | The first frame's start record, the created account's, charged before the first frame: for an absent leaf, given back once — by the table when the first frame succeeds, by the settlement when it reverts or is stopped; for a present leaf, standing when the first frame succeeds and given back by the settlement when it reverts or is stopped; on a halt the settlement gives back only the part the reservoir paid (`SATIN-HIST-005`) | As absent-leaf or present-leaf, by the leaf | As absent-leaf or present-leaf, by the leaf | As absent-leaf or present-leaf, by the leaf | The transaction's own frame for the table's give-back; the transaction, at its settlement, for the settlement's | The table's give-back in the first frame, or the settlement's |
| failed-create: a `CREATE` or `CREATE2` whose child reverts or halts (`SATIN-POOL-015`, `SATIN-HIST-014`, `SATIN-LIM-008`) | The creation's regular charges stay spent | `ACCOUNT_STATE_GAS × m`, charged with its legacy share when the address was empty under EIP-161, given back into the creator's reservoir after `SATIN-POOL-012` | The created account's record's history, when the opcode charged it (the transaction had not changed the address already), given back to the creator; the creator's nonce record, when the bump changes the creator's account from what the transaction loaded (none for the sender or for a creator already changed: `SATIN-HIST-009`, `SATIN-ACCT-008`), and its history are kept | The created account's rise is discarded | The created account's record is discarded; that creator's nonce record is counted on the creator | Likewise | The creator, into its reservoir | At the return: the reservoir join, the state give-back, the records' give-back, then the creator's nonce record counted |
| collision: a creation onto an address with code or a nonce (`SATIN-SD-016`, `SATIN-LIM-016`) | The creation's regular charges and its forward are spent | None: the address was not empty | The created account's record's history, when the opcode charged it, given back to the creator; the creator's nonce record, when the bump changes the creator's account from what the transaction loaded (none for the sender or for a creator already changed: `SATIN-HIST-009`, `SATIN-ACCT-008`), and its history kept | None | The created account's record discarded; that creator's nonce record counted on the creator | Likewise; no transfer log | The creator, into its reservoir, for the created account's record | As failed-create |

rows: first-frame-fails: the first frame reverts, halts or is stopped after the list applied (SATIN-AUTH-016, SATIN-STOP-011, SATIN-HIST-005, SATIN-POOL-024)
pre-frame-out-of-gas: a charge before the first frame that cannot be paid after part of the list applied (SATIN-SCHED-009, SATIN-SCHED-010, SATIN-HIST-005)
reset: an authority holding an indicator at the start, cleared and set again (SATIN-AUTH-009)
set-then-clear: two accepted authorizations for one authority holding no indicator at the start, a non-zero target and then the zero one (SATIN-AUTH-009, SATIN-SCHED-008)

skipped: a list whose KV or state-growth total would cross the transaction limit; the transaction's own frame is then stopped before it runs and settles as the own-frame row of SATIN-TAKE-011 and SATIN-STOP-009 state (SATIN-AUTH-010, SATIN-AUTH-011, SATIN-AUTH-013)
SATIN-TAKE-008.text:
- `SATIN-TAKE-008` An authorization list's writes, and their fate when the first frame fails or a charge before it cannot be paid, MUST be accounted as this table states, every charge being made on the transaction outside every frame in the order of `SATIN-SCHED-008`:

| Pattern | Regular gas and EIP-3529 refund | State gas | History gas | State growth | KV updates | Data size | Frame credited | Order |
| ------- | ------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------------ | ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ----- |
| set-then-clear: two accepted authorizations for one authority holding no indicator at the start, a non-zero target and then the zero one (`SATIN-AUTH-009`, `SATIN-SCHED-008`) | `ACCOUNT_WRITE` once, for the first write, unless the transaction already paid it — the sender, a value-bearing transaction's recipient (`SATIN-SCHED-008`, `SATIN-AUTH-015`); no refund for an existing authority (`SATIN-SCHED-007`) | `DELEGATION_STATE_GAS × m` once at the first; the clear charges none and gives none back; `ACCOUNT_STATE_GAS × m` once when the state holds no account for the authority (`SATIN-STATE-011`) | One record, `RECORD_HISTORY_GAS`, unless the authority is the sender (`SATIN-AUTH-008`, `SATIN-ACCT-008`) | +1 once when the state holds no account for it | +1 once, the sender excepted | `+WRITE_RECORD_SIZE` once, the sender excepted | No give-back | `SATIN-SCHED-008` step 2 for each entry, then step 3 |
| reset: an authority holding an indicator at the start, cleared and set again (`SATIN-AUTH-009`) | `ACCOUNT_WRITE` once, unless the transaction already paid it — the sender, a value-bearing transaction's recipient (`SATIN-SCHED-008`, `SATIN-AUTH-015`) | None for the indicator, and no new-account state gas: the authority exists | One record, `RECORD_HISTORY_GAS`, unless the authority is the sender (`SATIN-AUTH-008`, `SATIN-ACCT-008`) | None | +1, the sender excepted | `+WRITE_RECORD_SIZE`, the sender excepted | No give-back | `SATIN-SCHED-008` step 2, then step 3 |
| first-frame-fails: the first frame reverts, halts or is stopped after the list applied (`SATIN-AUTH-016`, `SATIN-STOP-011`, `SATIN-HIST-005`, `SATIN-POOL-024`) | The first frame's unspent regular gas returns, or a halt consumes it; what regular gas paid of the authorities' charges stays spent | The authorities' state gas is kept; the first frame's failure returns no reservoir those charges drew | The authorities' records' history is kept; the first frame's start record's history comes back into the transaction's reservoir on a revert or a stop, and on a halt only for the part the reservoir paid (`SATIN-HIST-005`) | The authorities' units are kept | The authorities' records are kept | Kept | The transaction, at its settlement | At the settlement |
| skipped: a list whose KV or state-growth total would cross the transaction limit; the transaction's own frame is then stopped before it runs and settles as the own-frame row of `SATIN-TAKE-011` and `SATIN-STOP-009` state (`SATIN-AUTH-010`, `SATIN-AUTH-011`, `SATIN-AUTH-013`) | The intrinsic gas stays; the rest settles as the stop's | None for the list; the first frame's recipient's or created account's state gas is charged and given back as in the own-frame row, the frame being stopped | None for the list; the body's stays; the first frame's start record is charged and given back as in the own-frame row | None | None | The body's stays | No give-back for the list, which charged nothing; the transaction, at its settlement, for the first frame's charges | Decided before any charge of the list (`SATIN-AUTH-010`) |
| pre-frame-out-of-gas: a charge before the first frame that cannot be paid after part of the list applied (`SATIN-SCHED-009`, `SATIN-SCHED-010`, `SATIN-HIST-005`) | The intrinsic gas stays; the rest of the regular budget is consumed; the sender keeps its fee and a call's nonce bump, and a creation's sender the bump the creation would have made | Every authority's charge taken back; the reservoir left returns to the sender | The authorities' records and the first frame's start record taken back; the body's stays | Taken back | Taken back | The body's stays | The sender, at the settlement | At the charge that cannot be paid; nothing runs after it |

rows: log-allowance: a log the frame's history allowance paid in whole or in part, in a frame that then fails (SATIN-HIST-019, SATIN-HIST-020)
log-reverted: a log in a frame that then reverts or halts, or whose caller later fails (SATIN-HIST-006, SATIN-POOL-014)
transfer-back: the transfer logs of a value sent and sent back (SATIN-LOG-001, SATIN-ACCT-006)

transfer-failed: a transfer log — of a value call, a creation's endowment, a SELFDESTRUCT or the transaction's value — in a frame that fails, or whose containing frame fails; a start's transfer log is the started frame's (SATIN-LOG-001, SATIN-LOG-002, SATIN-LOG-006)
SATIN-TAKE-009.text:
- `SATIN-TAKE-009` A log and a transfer log MUST be accounted as this table states; neither is a write record, and neither is taken back by a later write:

| Pattern | Regular gas and EIP-3529 refund | State gas | History gas | State growth | KV updates | Data size | Frame credited | Order |
| ------- | ------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------------ | ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ----- |
| log-reverted: a log in a frame that then reverts or halts, or whose caller later fails (`SATIN-HIST-006`, `SATIN-POOL-014`) | The log's regular charges stay spent | None | Given back by the rollback of the frame that fails: on a revert or a stop into its reservoir, whichever pool paid; on a halt the reservoir returns to what the frame received and the part regular gas paid is consumed | None | None | Discarded | The failing frame, by its rollback | Charged once the `LOG` completed and its bytes passed the limits; given back at the failing frame's end |
| log-allowance: a log the frame's history allowance paid in whole or in part, in a frame that then fails (`SATIN-HIST-019`, `SATIN-HIST-020`) | As log-reverted | None | The part the allowance paid: nothing returns, the allowance not being gas; the part the frame's gas paid: as log-reverted | None | None | Discarded | For the part the frame's gas paid, the failing frame's reservoir on a revert or a stop; on a halt the reservoir returns to what the frame received, which restores the part the reservoir paid, and the part regular gas paid is consumed; nothing for the part the allowance paid | The allowance first, then the frame's gas; the give-back at the failing frame's end |
| transfer-failed: a transfer log — of a value call, a creation's endowment, a `SELFDESTRUCT` or the transaction's value — in a frame that fails, or whose containing frame fails; a start's transfer log is the started frame's (`SATIN-LOG-001`, `SATIN-LOG-002`, `SATIN-LOG-006`) | None of its own | None | None: a transfer log pays none | None | None | `TRANSFER_LOG_SIZE` discarded with the failing frame's net | No give-back | Counted where the value moves, discarded at the failing frame's end |
| transfer-back: the transfer logs of a value sent and sent back (`SATIN-LOG-001`, `SATIN-ACCT-006`) | None of their own | None | None | None | None | `2 × TRANSFER_LOG_SIZE`, both kept while the records are taken back | No give-back | Each counted with its start |

rows: answer-stopped: a start answered without a frame — no code, a precompile's success — whose start crosses, and any frameless answer gas detention rewrites to the stop, an interceptor's answer among them (SATIN-STOP-014, SATIN-DET-022, SATIN-DET-025, SATIN-ICPT-005)
precompile-failed: a precompile that fails after its value moved (SATIN-LIM-014)

refused: a start that does not happen: a call refused for a value its caller cannot fund or past the call-depth limit, a call an interceptor answers or a sendHint its data-size check stops, and a creation its opcode refuses for the creator's nonce, the endowment or the depth (SATIN-HIST-023, SATIN-HIST-015, SATIN-LIM-015)
start-returns: a start whose value returns accounts to what the transaction loaded (SATIN-ACCT-006, SATIN-HIST-009)
start-stopped: a start a limit stops, held to the started frame's budget and then the transaction limit (SATIN-HIST-014, SATIN-STOP-013, SATIN-POOL-015, SATIN-LIM-013)
tx-start: the record of the transaction's own frame's start, its value's recipient or its created account (SATIN-HIST-005, SATIN-SCHED-008)
SATIN-TAKE-010.text:
- `SATIN-TAKE-010` The records, state and transfer log a frame start makes MUST be accounted as this table states, the caller paying the start's records' history after the forward and before the start is decided (`SATIN-HIST-023`), and the start being counted once it is decided (`SATIN-HIST-009`, `SATIN-HIST-014`, `SATIN-LIM-013`):

| Pattern | Regular gas and EIP-3529 refund | State gas | History gas | State growth | KV updates | Data size | Frame credited | Order |
| ------- | ------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------------ | ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ----- |
| start-stopped: a start a limit stops, held to the started frame's budget and then the transaction limit (`SATIN-HIST-014`, `SATIN-STOP-013`, `SATIN-POOL-015`, `SATIN-LIM-013`) | The opcode's regular charges stay spent; the child's regular gas, a value call's `CALL_STIPEND` included, returns untouched (`SATIN-POOL-012`) | A new-account or created-account charge, its legacy share included, is given back into the caller's reservoir | The start's records' history is given back to the caller when the stopped frame returns, but for a stopped creation's creator nonce record, which is kept and counted on the creator (`SATIN-STOP-015`) | Not kept | Not kept, the creator's nonce record excepted | Not kept: value, transfer log and created account are reverted; the creator's nonce record excepted | The caller, into its reservoir | At the stopped frame's return: the reservoir join, the state give-back, then the records' give-back |
| answer-stopped: a start answered without a frame — no code, a precompile's success — whose start crosses, and any frameless answer gas detention rewrites to the stop, an interceptor's answer among them (`SATIN-STOP-014`, `SATIN-DET-022`, `SATIN-DET-025`, `SATIN-ICPT-005`) | The answer is replaced by the stop on the child's untouched regular gas, a value call's `CALL_STIPEND` included | As start-stopped | As start-stopped | Not kept | Not kept | Not kept | The caller, into its reservoir | As start-stopped |
| refused: a start that does not happen: a call refused for a value its caller cannot fund or past the call-depth limit, a call an interceptor answers or a `sendHint` its data-size check stops, and a creation its opcode refuses for the creator's nonce, the endowment or the depth (`SATIN-HIST-023`, `SATIN-HIST-015`, `SATIN-LIM-015`) | The opcode's regular charges before the refusal or the answer stay spent; a call returns the child's regular gas whole, a value call's `CALL_STIPEND` included, less only what an answer itself charges (`SATIN-POOL-012`, `SATIN-ICPT-004`) | A value `CALL` to an account empty under EIP-161 is charged `ACCOUNT_STATE_GAS × m`, its legacy share from regular gas first, and given it back into its reservoir at the return; a refused creation charges none | A value its caller cannot fund makes no record and is charged none, and a refused creation is charged none; a value call its caller can fund that is past the call-depth limit, or that interception answers or stops, was charged the history of the records its transfer would make, after the forward, and is given it back at the return | None | None | None: no transfer log | The caller, for the state charge and for the records' history where it was charged, into its reservoir | The opcode's charges, then the decision that refuses or answers; at the return the reservoir join, the state give-back, then the records' give-back |
| precompile-failed: a precompile that fails after its value moved (`SATIN-LIM-014`) | The forward is consumed | As failed-new for an empty recipient | The start's records' history is given back to the caller | None | None | None | The caller, into its reservoir | At the failed answer's return |
| start-returns: a start whose value returns accounts to what the transaction loaded (`SATIN-ACCT-006`, `SATIN-HIST-009`) | The call's regular charges | None | No charge for the records it takes back; their price is given back to the caller once the frame returned with its start kept | None | Each record taken back, on the started frame's net | `−WRITE_RECORD_SIZE` each, on the started frame's net, `+TRANSFER_LOG_SIZE` | The caller, into its reservoir | The take-back counted when the start is decided; the history given back once the frame returned with its start kept |
| tx-start: the record of the transaction's own frame's start, its value's recipient or its created account (`SATIN-HIST-005`, `SATIN-SCHED-008`) | None of its own | The recipient's or created account's state gas is the first frame's, given back into the transaction's reservoir when that frame reverts or is stopped, and on a halt only for the part the reservoir paid, the part regular gas paid being consumed (`SATIN-POOL-015`) | Charged before the first frame; comes back, into the transaction's reservoir, when the first frame reverts or is stopped; on a halt only the part the reservoir paid returns (`SATIN-HIST-005`) | The first frame's | The first frame's | The first frame's | The transaction, at its settlement | `SATIN-SCHED-008` step 3 for the record and step 4 for the state gas; both given back at the settlement |

rows: creator-survives: the creator's nonce record across a failed or stopped creation, when the bump made one — not for the sender or a creator already changed (SATIN-LIM-008, SATIN-STOP-015, SATIN-HIST-009)
hint-survives: an Oracle hint the failed frame admitted (SATIN-STOP-012, SATIN-ORCL-009)
own-frame: the transaction's own frame fails, a deposit's halt excepted, which is the failed-deposit row of SATIN-TAKE-012 (SATIN-POOL-017, SATIN-STOP-009, SATIN-POOL-015)
reverted: a frame below the transaction's own reverts (SATIN-POOL-014, SATIN-TAKE-004)
stopped: a limit stop, or gas detention's crossing (SATIN-STOP-004, SATIN-STOP-005, SATIN-DET-018)
SATIN-TAKE-011.text:
- `SATIN-TAKE-011` A frame that fails MUST be accounted as this table states, whatever writes and take-backs it made:

| Pattern | Regular gas and EIP-3529 refund | State gas | History gas | State growth | KV updates | Data size | Frame credited | Order |
| ------- | ------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------------ | ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ----- |
| reverted: a frame below the transaction's own reverts (`SATIN-POOL-014`, `SATIN-TAKE-004`) | Its unspent regular gas returns to the caller; the part of its charges regular gas paid stays spent and goes into its reservoir; its refund-counter changes are discarded | Every charge it made and merged, net of the give-backs it received, is given back into its reservoir by `reservoir = reservoir + net_charged` (`SATIN-POOL-014`), the reservoir a failed child returned to it staying there | As state gas | Its net is discarded | Its net is discarded; records it took back stand again | Its net is discarded | The failed frame, by its rollback; the caller then joins its reservoir by `SATIN-POOL-012` | At the frame's end; the caller then joins its reservoir (`SATIN-POOL-012`) |
| halted: an exceptional halt (`SATIN-POOL-014`, `SATIN-OUT-007`) | Its regular gas, with the part of its charges regular gas paid, is consumed; the refund-counter changes are discarded | Its reservoir becomes the share it received, which returns to the caller | As this row's state gas: the reservoir it received is restored and the part of its history charges regular gas paid is consumed, nothing of it returning; no history charge of the frame remains on the history ledger | Discarded | Discarded | Discarded | As reverted, but no regular gas returns | As reverted |
| stopped: a limit stop, or gas detention's crossing (`SATIN-STOP-004`, `SATIN-STOP-005`, `SATIN-DET-018`) | As reverted; for gas detention, the frame's gas is put back to what it was before the crossing charge | As reverted | As reverted | As reverted; the crossing write is not counted | As reverted | As reverted | As reverted | At the crossing, then as reverted |
| creator-survives: the creator's nonce record across a failed or stopped creation, when the bump made one — not for the sender or a creator already changed (`SATIN-LIM-008`, `SATIN-STOP-015`, `SATIN-HIST-009`) | None | None | Kept | A creator account the bump creates is kept | Counted on the creator | Counted on the creator | No give-back | Counted on the creator at the creation's return |
| hint-survives: an Oracle hint the failed frame admitted (`SATIN-STOP-012`, `SATIN-ORCL-009`) | None | None | None | None | None | Stays counted on the transaction | No give-back | Counted when the hint is admitted |
| own-frame: the transaction's own frame fails, a deposit's halt excepted, which is the failed-deposit row of `SATIN-TAKE-012` (`SATIN-POOL-017`, `SATIN-STOP-009`, `SATIN-POOL-015`) | Unspent regular gas returns to the sender, unless the frame halted | On a revert or a stop the recipient's or created account's state gas charged before the frame is given back into the transaction's reservoir; on a halt only the part the reservoir paid returns, the part regular gas paid being consumed, the pre-frame charges' included; the reservoir left returns to the sender | The first frame's start record comes back into the transaction's reservoir on a revert or a stop, and on a halt only for the part the reservoir paid (`SATIN-HIST-005`) | What was counted before the first frame stays | Likewise | Likewise | The sender, at the settlement | At the settlement |

rows: deposit-reverted: a deposit whose own frame reverts or is stopped (SATIN-STOP-010, SATIN-STOP-011, SATIN-DEP-003)
failed-deposit: a deposit that fails validation, cannot pay a charge made before its first frame, or whose own frame halts (SATIN-DEP-004, SATIN-DEP-005, SATIN-DEP-006, SATIN-ACCT-020)
SATIN-TAKE-012.text:
- `SATIN-TAKE-012` A deposit MUST be accounted as this table states; a deposit pays history gas as any transaction does, so the history cells of the tables above hold for it (`SATIN-HIST-016`), and it reports the history bytes it keeps (`SATIN-HIST-022`):

| Pattern | Regular gas and EIP-3529 refund | State gas | History gas | State growth | KV updates | Data size | Frame credited | Order |
| ------- | ------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | ------------ | ---------- | --------- | -------------- | ----- |
| failed-deposit: a deposit that fails validation, cannot pay a charge made before its first frame, or whose own frame halts (`SATIN-DEP-004`, `SATIN-DEP-005`, `SATIN-DEP-006`, `SATIN-ACCT-020`) | The whole gas limit, reported as regular gas; no refund | None, a created caller's included | None | +1 for a caller empty under EIP-161, uncharged; everything else taken back | Every record taken back: zero | The body and the admitted hints stay; everything else taken back | No give-back: nothing returns to the sender, the reservoir and the withheld gas included | At the deposit's end, in place of the settlement |
| deposit-reverted: a deposit whose own frame reverts or is stopped (`SATIN-STOP-010`, `SATIN-STOP-011`, `SATIN-DEP-003`) | As any revert of the own frame | The created caller's `ACCOUNT_STATE_GAS × m` is kept; the frame's charges come back by its rollback | The body's is kept; the frame's charges come back by its rollback, as own-frame | The created caller's +1 is kept; the frame's net is discarded | The frame's net is discarded | The body and hints stay; the frame's net is discarded | The sender, at the settlement | As own-frame |

SATIN-VAL-001.section: Specification > What a transaction is rejected for
SATIN-VAL-001.text:
- `SATIN-VAL-001` A transaction MUST be rejected when its body, with `WRITE_RECORD_SIZE` bytes for every entry of its authorization list, exceeds the transaction's data-size limit (see [Resource Limits](../evm/resource-limits.md)), unless it is system-originated (see [Mega System Transactions](../system-contracts/system-tx.md)).
  Every entry counts, whether its authorization will apply or not.
  The body's size is the one [Resource Accounting](../evm/resource-accounting.md) counts as data size.

SATIN-VAL-002.section: Specification > What a transaction is rejected for

SATIN-VAL-004.text: - `SATIN-VAL-004` The body and the records of the authorities a transaction applies are all the data size it counts before its first frame, so a transaction that passes validation MUST NOT be stopped by the data-size limit before its first frame.

SATIN-VAL-005.section: Specification > What a transaction is rejected for
SATIN-VAL-005.text: - `SATIN-VAL-005` A transaction whose caller is the live system address and that does not have the system shape MUST be rejected, unless it is a deposit (see [Mega System Transactions](../system-contracts/system-tx.md), `SATIN-MST-003`).

SATIN-VAL-006.section: Specification > What a transaction is rejected for
SATIN-VAL-006.text:
- `SATIN-VAL-006` A transaction MUST be rejected when it carries a chain id that is not the chain's, or when it is a typed transaction (any type but legacy and deposit) and carries none.
  A legacy transaction without a chain id (pre-[EIP-155](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-155)) is valid, unless it is a Mega System Transaction, which MUST carry one (`SATIN-MST-005`).
  A node MUST make this check whatever its configuration says.

SATIN-VAL-007.section: Specification > What a transaction is rejected for
SATIN-VAL-007.text: - `SATIN-VAL-007` A transaction MUST be rejected when it is a Mega System Transaction that fails its chain-id, nonce or EIP-3607 check (`SATIN-MST-005`), and when it fails any validation of the base layer (see [Base Layer](../base-layer.md)).

SATIN-VAL-008.text:
- `SATIN-VAL-008` A deposit MUST NOT be rejected for failing a validation check: a deposit that fails any check of this page, or of the base layer, MUST be included as a failed deposit instead (see [Deposit Transactions](deposits.md)).
  A Mega System Transaction is a legacy transaction until it has passed its own chain-id, nonce and EIP-3607 checks, so failing one of those is a rejection; once it has passed them it runs as a deposit, and a check it fails after that includes it as a failed deposit.
  A read the node fails to make is not a validation check, for a deposit as for any transaction: it is a fault (`SATIN-VAL-010`).

SATIN-VAL-009.text: - `SATIN-VAL-009` Retired, removed: what a transaction pool can decide without state is node documentation, outside the specification.

SATIN-WIT-002.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-002` A transaction MUST load every account and slot its execution reads from the state: in its validation, in its fee settlement, and in any of its frames — a frame that reverted, halted or was stopped, and a frame of a deposit that failed, included.
  A failed frame's writes are taken back, not its reads; a failed deposit takes back everything but its sender's nonce bump and mint, not its reads.

SATIN-WIT-003.text: - `SATIN-WIT-003` The L1 block information a transaction is priced against, and the data-availability footprint gas scalar every non-deposit transaction reads before it runs, are read outside the transaction's journal, and every account and slot such a read makes MUST be reported with the transaction that made it (`SATIN-WIT-011`).

SATIN-WIT-004.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-004` A read that gas or a limit skipped MUST load nothing (`SATIN-WIT-012`), with one exception: an authority account the EIP-7702 authorization preflight consulted MUST be loaded, with its code, whether or not the list is then applied.
  The preflight consults every authority whose entry passes the chain-id, nonce and signature gates, each distinct authority once, the whole list walked (see [EIP-7702 Authorizations Before the First Frame](../evm/authorizations.md)).

SATIN-WIT-005.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-005` Execution MUST report what it loaded in the states the block commits: each pre-block step in the state it commits on its own, and each transaction in its returned state, which names every account and slot the transaction loaded, whether it wrote it or not, whether the frame that loaded it succeeded or not, and, for a deposit, whether the deposit failed or not.
  The set of loads is a function of those states and of the exports alone, not of how the node caches state: a state names the keys it loaded even when a cache another block filled served the value.
  A state names the keys; the values are the chain's.

SATIN-WIT-006.text: - `SATIN-WIT-006` A slot of an account the chain does not hold before the block MUST NOT be recorded: such an account has no storage, and a validator MUST answer every slot of it with zero without looking it up.

SATIN-WIT-007.text: - `SATIN-WIT-007` The code a witness holds MUST be the chain's before the block, not the code a returned state carries: a transaction that replaces an account's code — an EIP-7702 authority delegated anew — is admitted against the code the chain held, and its returned state carries the code it wrote.

SATIN-WIT-008.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-008` A transaction's loads MUST be in its returned state: its sender, its recipient or created address, every account and every slot any of its frames loads, the fee recipients, every authority account the authorization preflight consulted, and a keyless deployment's signer and deploy address; the state names an account whether or not the load brought its code.
  The pre-block phase's loads MUST be in the states it commits, one per step and in the step order of [System Calls and the Pre-Block Sequence](system-calls.md): the EIP-2935 call's state, the EIP-4788 call's state, in Satin's activation block the factory's read-only entry, each system contract's deployment — the account it installed or rewrote, or the read-only entry of one it left as it was —, the registry's account and pending slots the due-change read loaded, the `applyPendingChanges()` call's state when the call is made, the registry's deployment, and last the registry's account and slot 0 the resolution of the live system address read.
  Each state MUST be committed whole, read-only entries included, and a node MUST collect the states as they are committed: what a commit keeps of a state is only what it changed, which holds none of the read-only entries.

SATIN-WIT-009.text: - `SATIN-WIT-009` `BLOCKHASH` reads the chain's history outside the transaction's journal, and its reads MUST be exported (`SATIN-WIT-014`); a SALT bucket's capacity is read outside the database, and MUST be exported (`SATIN-WIT-013`); the L1 block information a fee computation or a footprint reads is read outside the transaction's journal, and MUST be reported with the transaction that read it (`SATIN-WIT-011`).

SATIN-WIT-010.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-010` A validator MUST be given, beside the witness: the block's header, the chain configuration (its fork schedule), the parent block's hash and timestamp, the parent beacon block root, and the block's extra data.
  Whether the block admits only deposits, and whether Satin activates in it, MUST be derived from the chain configuration and the two timestamps, as [Activation and Rex-Era Carry-Over](activation.md) specifies; `SLOTNUM` pushes zero (see [Base Layer](../base-layer.md)), so no slot number is an input.

SATIN-WIT-011.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-011` The L1 block contract at `L1_BLOCK_ADDRESS` is read, when it is needed, by two reads of the base layer:
  - a non-deposit transaction that pays an L1 fee is priced by the fee computation, which reads its L1 base fee slot (1), its Ecotone fee scalars slot (3), its Ecotone blob base fee slot (7), its operator fee scalars slot (8), and, only when the Ecotone scalars are empty (the blob base fee scalar and the eight bytes of the two scalars zero), its L1 fee overhead slot (5);
  - every non-deposit transaction, a Mega System Transaction included, which pays no fee, has its data-availability footprint computed from the footprint gas scalar, read from slot 8 before the transaction runs (see [Base Layer](../base-layer.md), `SATIN-BASE-009`).

  These reads are made on the block's state, not through a transaction's journal, so they land in no transaction's returned state; the node MUST nevertheless report the contract's account and every slot the block's transactions read by either, each once, as read-only entries of the state of the first transaction that read it, whether for its fee or for its footprint, so that the witness holds them; a read-only entry does not replace a write that transaction makes to the same account or slot.
  A block whose only non-deposit transactions are Mega System Transactions therefore still reports the account and slot 8, with the first of them, though no transaction of it pays an L1 fee.
  A state that holds no contract at the address MUST record the account as absent and read no slot.
  A slot neither read reaches is not read and need not be in the witness: a block with no non-deposit transaction reads none of it, and a slot the scalars leave unread is not read.
  A read the node fails to make is reported as `SATIN-VAL-010` classifies it: a fee computation's as a read of the transaction's own execution, the footprint scalar's as a read the block makes for the transaction (see [Transaction Validation and Refusals](transaction-validation.md)).
  The reads change nothing: the entries are not written.

SATIN-WIT-012.section: Specification > Reads a validator makes again
SATIN-WIT-012.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-012` A read that gas or a limit skipped is skipped again on replay, so the witness MUST NOT be required to carry it: a cold `SLOAD` or account load with less whole regular gas than its cold surcharge, other than an Oracle read, which is made before its charge (`SATIN-ORCL-004`), a `BLOCKHASH` of the current block, a future block or a block outside the last `BLOCKHASH_WINDOW` blocks, a read refused in a frame whose volatile-data access is off, a keyless deployment's reads after a step refused it, and the bucket of a state charge a system-originated transaction or a system call makes.
  A call's completed read of its target's account and code is not among them: it MUST stay in the witness when the call's delegate is then refused, and when the target's cold surcharge is then gas detention's crossing ([MegaAccessControl](../system-contracts/mega-access-control.md), `SATIN-MAC-007`).

SATIN-WIT-013.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-013` Block execution MUST export the set of SALT buckets the SALT environment answered with a valid capacity during the block, emptied when the block starts and accumulated over everything executed for the block.
  A bucket is in the set once it was answered with a valid capacity, whether or not the transaction that asked is in the block.
  A lookup that failed MUST NOT be in the set, whether the environment could not answer it or answered a capacity below `MIN_BUCKET_SIZE`: it is a fault of the node, for a deposit as for any transaction (see [Halts, Reverts and Stops](../evm/outcomes.md)).
  A witness MUST prove the capacity of every bucket in the set.
  A node that runs the block's transactions on several executions, or that empties the set between transactions, MUST take the union of what each reports; a transaction executed elsewhere and committed into the block adds nothing to the set of the execution it was committed into.
  The pre-block calls and the system-originated transactions price at `m = 1` and add no bucket.
  Which bucket an account or a slot lands in is SALT's own definition (see [State Gas and SALT Pricing](../evm/state-gas.md)).

SATIN-WIT-014.text: - `SATIN-WIT-014` Block execution MUST export every block hash `BLOCKHASH` was served during the block, emptied when the block starts; it is not what a node's state cache holds, which may carry hashes an earlier block read.

SATIN-WIT-015.text: - `SATIN-WIT-015` Retired, removed: no record of the oracle service's answers is kept beside the block; the sequencer persists before its reader every served value the reader's own writes do not explain (see [Oracle](../system-contracts/oracle.md), `SATIN-ORCL-012`), and a transaction whose reads of a slot no value written before it reproduces is not included (`SATIN-ORCL-013`).

SATIN-WIT-016.text:
- `SATIN-WIT-016` A block replayed on exactly its witness MUST produce the same receipts, state changes, gas ledgers, logs and block counters as the block's execution, and MUST read nothing the witness does not hold.
  Its exports MUST be a subset of the building node's, and MAY be a proper one: the building node's also hold the buckets and block hashes that candidates it executed and dropped asked for.
  A validator reads every Oracle value from the slot (`SATIN-ORCL-012`), and hints, which reach the service alone, are not in the witness.

SATIN-WIT-017.text: - `SATIN-WIT-017` A node MUST answer an address its state holds no account for as no account, never as an empty account, which is a leaf the state holds: the destruction table gives an account's leaf back only when no account stood at the address at the transaction's start (see [SELFDESTRUCT and the Destruction Table](../evm/selfdestruct.md)).
